summary: Verified Óptica dashboard timezone fix end-to-end. Server time during test: 2026-11-03 04:17 UTC = 2026-11-02 22:17 Guatemala, which is exactly the window where the old UTC-midnight logic would have failed. Baseline ventas-dia (2 orders, Q150) -> created a POS V2 sale (accessory 'Estuche rígido' Q45, Efectivo, Consumidor Final) -> ORD-202611-0003. ventas-dia then returned total_ventas +45, num_ordenes +1, total_cobrado +45, and the order_number was in the ventas array, with fecha 2026-11-02 (GT). cuentas_por_cobrar = Q10,350 / 10, which matches the DB sum of balance_due for status=pendiente. rentabilidad returns total_compras, num_compras and utilidad, and utilidad == total_ingresos - total_compras for dia/semana/mes/año. On the UI, all 7 cards render with Quetzal values (Ventas Hoy Q195 / 3 órdenes after the new sale) and the Ventas del Día (3) table lists ORD-202611-0003. 7/7 pytest passed. UI checks passed.

minor.issue: Period start is still in UTC (now.replace(day=1...) on datetime.now(timezone.utc)). The month, day and year cards therefore use UTC boundaries, not GT ones. Example: sales from 18:00-23:59 GT on the last day of a month are counted in the next month, and periodo=dia starts at 18:00 GT of the previous day. It should use rango_gt_a_utc / now_gt like ventas-dia does. ventas-por-origen has the same UTC default.

The total_compras filter compares purchase_date >= fecha_inicio.isoformat() ('2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00'). If purchase_date is stored date-only ('2026-11-01'), purchases dated the 1st of the month are left out, because a string compare puts '2026-11-01' before '2026-11-01T...'. Not verified with data: optica_purchases is empty in preview. Use a GT date string such as today_gt().replace(day=1).isoformat() for the comparison.

total_ingresos (used by the Ingresos and Utilidad cards) sums item subtotals before the sale discount, so revenue is overstated whenever discounts are applied. Consider subtracting discount_amount or using sale.total.

issues: 7 cards in a lg:grid-cols-4 grid leave an empty slot on row 2. Cosmetic: use grid-cols-7, 4+3 centered, or add an 8th card.
Card labels say '(mes)' using the raw periodoRentabilidad value and change with the selector, while the data-testids say '-mes'. Cosmetic only.
